title: Getting better visual art results from Godot and Ziva
author: MarthinusViljoen
selftext:
So I've been trying Godot for a second time to make my game. My first attempt I was too vague with my instructions, and it got messed up. So I went back to the drawing board and expanded on a lot of detail before starting a new project. It seems to be going well so far, I'm using Ziva agent with GPT which is at the top of the recommendations list at the moment. The logical creation is working, but I've given it several images that I designed for what the game menus should look like, but it made it different, and poorer in quality than the images I uploaded. I tried twice to point Ziva to the image, and instruct it to make the menu that way, but it always looks the same as it had been made by Ziva/Godot the first time.

Is there something specific I must do? Use a different AI with Ziva?
